summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to include physical and occupational therapists as health professionals who can provide falls risk assessments and prevention services during Medicare annual wellness visits and initial preventive physical examinations for individuals who have fallen in the previous year, and requires annual reports to Congress on falls among seniors.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include physical and occupational therapists for falls risk assessments and prevention services during annual wellness visits and initial preventive physical examinations. This represents an expansion of services covered under a public healthcare program, making healthcare more accessible for seniors at risk of falls.
